tone.summary: A punchy, dry rhythmic tone achieved with a light overdrive, followed by a clean British amp model (UK 45) to emphasize the attack and tightness, keeping all ambience low.

blocks.purpose: Clean up any unwanted hum or noise from the percussive strumming.

No dedicated distortion needed; the Green OD provides enough punch.
Select a classic British clean tone that is punchy and defined, avoiding the overdriven grit of Marshall models.
Provide a classic, full-bodied British sound that complements the UK 45 amp model.
Tighten the low end and boost the mid-range to emphasize the rhythmic attack and punch.
No wah needed; the focus is on dry percussive rhythm.

Add minimal, natural ambience to prevent the sound from being too sterile, while keeping it dry.
